task.title: Example Planning
task.shortdesc: A worked example of a build plan

taskbody.context: The first step in building a desktop is to develop a plan

step.info: I want to build a new mid-range PC that can also play games at good settings for the next few years.
My current PC is very old and most of its parts are too obsolete for re-use. I can salvage my case, storage drive, monitor, and other peripherals though.
